title: [AI-BIO-01] Structure-Guided Allosteric JAK2 V617F JH2 Mutant-Selective Inhibitor / PROTAC Degrader Design
wet_lab_execution_model: Zero internal wet lab required for hit-to-lead: pair in-silico MD/free-energy perturbation (FEP+) & generative pocket design on PDB 4FVR/6E2Q/8BAK/8EX2 (V617F JH2) vs 4FVP (WT JH2) with fee-for-service biochemical binding panels (Eurofins DiscoverX / Reaction Biology JH2 vs JH1 selectivity assays + isogenic Ba/F3 EPOR V617F vs WT cell lines).
problem_wedge: All 4 FDA-approved JAK inhibitors (ruxolitinib, fedratinib, pacritinib, momelotinib) are Type I ATP-competitive binders of the conserved JH1 catalytic domain, inhibiting wild-type JAK2 alongside mutant JAK2 V617F. This causes dose-limiting anemia and thrombocytopenia, induces JAK2 heterodimer persistence, fails to eradicate mutant HSC clones, and leads to ~50% ruxolitinib discontinuation within 3 years (median post-discontinuation OS: 11-23 months). While first-gen reversible JH2 binders (INCB160058, NCT06313593) and Type II DFG-out binders (AJ1-11095, NCT06343805) just entered Phase 1, catalytic JH2-selective degraders (PROTACs/molecular glues) that eliminate scaffolding remain wide open.
solution_blueprint: Design next-generation small-molecule allosteric binders or V617F-selective heterobifunctional degraders (PROTACs recruiting CRBN/VHL/DCAF) targeting the mutated JH2 pseudokinase pocket (p.Val617Phe aromatic pi-stacking rearrangement) achieving >50x selectivity over wild-type JAK2/JAK1/TYK2 to enable catalytic clonal clearance without myelosuppression.

unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: ~15,000-25,000 US Myelofibrosis patients (~50-60% JAK2 V617F+) + >150,000 Polycythemia Vera (>95% JAK2 V617F+) & Essential Thrombocythemia expansion; Ruxolitinib exceeds $4.5B/yr global revenue.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Preclinical/Phase 1 mutant-selective kinase assets transact for $80M-$400M+ upfront/option packages (benchmarks: Prelude-Incyte INCB160058 alliance, Ajax Therapeutics AJ1-11095); single-asset MF biotechs exit at $1.7B-$2.9B.

regulatory_pathway: FDA Orphan Drug Designation (7-yr exclusivity, 100% waiver of FY2026 $4,682,003 PDUFA filing fee, 25% QCTE tax credit) + Fast Track in post-ruxolitinib MF.
first_90_days_milestones: Benchmark structural dynamics and exit vectors across PDB 4FVR, 6E2Q, 8BAK, and 8EX2 (JAK2 V617F JH2) vs PDB 4FVP (WT JH2) against ChEMBL CHEMBL2971 ligands.
Run virtual screen / generative ternary-complex design optimizing JH2-V617F vs JH2-WT delta-delta-G selectivity and non-JH1 hinge binding.
Order 30-50 custom/Make-on-Demand analogs or linker-warhead pairs ($25K-$45K) and screen in outsourced JH2-WT vs JH2-V617F TR-FRET competition and HiBiT degradation assays.
Submit NCI SBIR Phase I ($400K) and MPN Research Foundation MPN Challenge ($250K) LOI with initial selectivity curves.

title: [AI-BIO-03] Single-Cell Megakaryocyte-Stroma Drug Repurposing Screen for Direct Bone Marrow Fibrosis Reversal

title: [AI-BIO-04] Subtractive Spatial Multi-Omics: Steroid-Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis as 'Nature's Positive Control' for Fibrosis Reversal

title: [AI-BIO-05] Structure-Guided UBA1c-to-UBA1b Ubiquitin-Activation Rescue & Mutant Clone Synthetic-Lethal Screen
wet_lab_execution_model: In-silico pocket & perturbation modeling on human UBA1 structures (PDB:6DC6) and VEXAS bone-marrow single-cell multi-omics (GEO:GSE163683) paired with outsourced CRO ubiquitin-thioester enzymatic & isogenic UBA1-M41 THP-1/HSPCs screening.
problem_wedge: Discovered in Oct 2020 (Beck et al., NEJM), somatic UBA1 p.Met41Thr/Val/Leu mutations abolish cytoplasmic UBA1b translation and produce catalytically impaired UBA1c, driving severe adult-onset autoinflammation, vacuolated myeloid precursors, macrocytic anemia, and ~40-50% 5-year mortality in high-risk cohorts. Zero FDA-approved therapies exist; chronic high-dose glucocorticoids cause lethal infections, while JAK inhibitors (ruxolitinib, pacritinib PAXIS NCT06538181) control cytokines without eradicating UBA1-mutant HSC clones.
solution_blueprint: Design small-molecule allosteric activators restoring residual UBA1c ubiquitin-charging efficiency OR synthetic-lethal ubiquitin-proteasome / unfolded-protein-response (PERK/IRE1a) inhibitors that selectively collapse ubiquitin-starved UBA1-M41 myeloid clones while sparing wild-type UBA1b hematopoiesis.

unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Estimated ~1 in 4,200 men >50 yrs (~15,000+ US patients, rapidly expanding as UBA1 sequencing enters standard panels) — identical population scale to Primary Myelofibrosis with zero approved drugs.

title: [AI-BIO-06] Multi-Omic Proteomic Stratification & 505(b)(2) JAK1/2-mTOR Combination Repurposing for Siltuximab-Refractory iMCD

Partner with CDCN reference pathologists for blinded inter-observer concordance benchmarking.
Publish open benchmark and deploy free clinician second-opinion triage portal.

title: [AI-BIO-07] Blood-Brain-Barrier-Excluded & Wild-Type-Sparing KIT D816V Degrader / Allosteric Inhibitor Design
wet_lab_execution_model: Computational ADME/P-gp efflux + mutant-vs-WT structural selectivity design on KIT crystal structures (PDB:4U0I, PDB:1T46) + outsourced kinome & HMC-1.2 mast-cell CRO assays.
problem_wedge: Over 90% of Systemic Mastocytosis (ORPHA:2467 — Indolent & Advanced SM, ~30,000+ US patients) is driven by a single somatic activation-loop mutation: KIT p.Asp816Val (D816V). First-in-class avapritinib (PIONEER NCT03731260) proved blockbuster orphan demand (> $500M-$1B+ trajectory) yet crosses the blood-brain barrier—causing cognitive impairment ('brain fog' in 10-30% of patients) and intracranial bleeding risk at higher doses, while off-target PDGFRa/WT-KIT inhibition limits chronic indolent dosing. Next-gen ATP-competitive inhibitors bezuclastinib (SUMMIT NCT05186753) and elenestinib (HARBOR NCT04910685) validate the massive commercial prize for peripheral-restricted precision.
solution_blueprint: Design P-gp/BCRP-substrate peripheral-restricted heterobifunctional degraders or non-hinge allosteric binders selective for KIT D816V over WT KIT, PDGFRa/b, CSF1R, and FLT3 (>100x window, Kp,uu <0.02), eliminating mutant mast-cell burden without CNS neurotoxicity or cytopenias.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $130,000 - $350,000 (MD + P-gp efflux multiparameter generative design + MDCK-MDR1 permeability + KIT D816V vs WT/PDGFRa CRO panel)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Blueprint Medicines' Ayvakit (avapritinib) franchise drove Sanofi's >$9B acquisition benchmark in 2025; Indolent SM is a lifelong chronic orphan market.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Best-in-class peripheral-restricted KIT D816V degraders represent premier $250M-$1B+ preclinical/Phase 1 pharma acquisition targets.

regulatory_pathway: FDA Orphan Drug Designation (Advanced & Indolent Systemic Mastocytosis) + Fast Track.
first_90_days_milestones: Model active-state KIT D816V activation loop vs autoinhibited WT KIT (PDB:1T46, PDB:4U0I) and PDGFRa counter-targets.
Co-optimize ternary degrader / allosteric warheads for strict P-gp efflux (CNS exclusion Kp,uu <0.02) and oral bioavailability.
Synthesize 25-40 compounds via CRO and test in DiscoverX KIT(D816V) vs KIT(WT)/PDGFRA + MDCK-MDR1 bidirectional transport assays.
File composition-of-matter provisional patent and apply for NIAID/NHLBI SBIR Phase I.

title: [PUBLIC-HEALTH-07] High-Sensitivity Peripheral KIT D816V ddPCR + Hereditary Alpha-Tryptasemia (TPSAB1) Allergy/GI Triage Network
wet_lab_execution_model: Zero wet lab: EHR/allergy-clinic risk stratification + mail-in dried-blood-spot / peripheral-blood ddPCR & TPSAB1 copy-number coordination via existing CLIA partner labs.
problem_wedge: Indolent Systemic Mastocytosis patients endure a median 6-to-8 year diagnostic delay across allergy, GI ('refractory IBS'), and endocrinology ('idiopathic osteoporosis / Hymenoptera anaphylaxis') because standard NGS misses low-VAF (<0.01-0.1%) peripheral KIT D816V, leading clinicians to skip workup—or confuse clonal SM with Hereditary Alpha-Tryptasemia (TPSAB1 triplication, present in ~5% of the population and enriched in SM).
solution_blueprint: Build a REMA-score + basal serum tryptase clinical triage engine across community allergy & GI networks that triggers paired ultra-sensitive peripheral-blood KIT D816V digital-droplet PCR (VAF sensitivity 0.01%) + buccal TPSAB1 copy-number genotyping, avoiding unnecessary marrow biopsies in pure HaT while accelerating clonal SM patients to precision trials (HARBOR NCT04910685).

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $40,000 - $110,000 (REMA/tryptase FHIR workflow + CLIA lab API integration + TMS patient advisory review)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Multiple commercial & Phase 3 KIT inhibitor sponsors actively fund non-promotional diagnostic-pathway & trial-screening programs ($10K-$25K per identified clonal SM trial candidate).
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: High-margin specialty allergy/hematology diagnostic routing & sponsored testing network.

regulatory_pathway: Transparent REMA-score clinical decision support + CLIA-validated partner ddPCR/TPSAB1 laboratory testing.
first_90_days_milestones: Implement validated REMA anaphylaxis score + tryptase-adjusted TPSAB1 copy-number calculator (`10 + 9*extra_alpha_copies` ng/mL threshold) as an open API/widget.
Partner with The Mast Cell Disease Society (TMS) and 5 regional allergy/anaphylaxis practices for workflow pilot.
Integrate mail-in peripheral KIT D816V ddPCR reflex ordering with a CLIA molecular hematology lab.
Establish clinical-trial referral contracts for active non-advanced SM studies (NCT04910685).

title: [AI-BIO-08] Oral Non-Hormonal PAPD5 (TENT4B) Inhibitor Restoring Endogenous TERC Telomerase RNA & Stem-Cell Telomeres
wet_lab_execution_model: Structure-guided medicinal optimization on human PAPD5/TENT4B & telomerase holoenzyme (PDB:7BG9) + outsourced TERC 3'-oligoadenylation & patient-iPSC HSPC Flow-FISH telomere elongation CRO assays.
problem_wedge: Dyskeratosis Congenita & Telomere Biology Disorders (TBD, ORPHA:1775 — germline TERT, TERC, DKC1, PARN, RTEL1 mutations) cause lethal pediatric/adult bone marrow failure, pulmonary fibrosis, liver cirrhosis, and squamous cancers with zero FDA-approved targeted therapies. High-dose androgen danazol attenuated telomere attrition in NIH Phase 1/2 (NCT01441037, Townsley et al. NEJM) but causes dose-limiting hepatotoxicity, lipid derangements, and virilization. Seminal genetic studies (Nagpal & Agarwal, Blood/Cell Stem Cell) proved inhibiting poly(A) polymerase PAPD5 (TENT4B) blocks exosome degradation of TERC RNA and restores physiological telomere length in human TBD stem cells.
solution_blueprint: Optimize selective, marrow- and lung-penetrant oral small-molecule PAPD5 (TENT4B) catalytic inhibitors (improving over CNS-toxic viral-hepatitis scaffold RG7834 via polarity/efflux tuning) to elevate endogenous TERC levels 2-3x and rescue telomerase activity across DKC1, PARN, and TERC-haploinsufficient marrow & alveolar stem cells.

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $140,000 - $350,000 (CNS-excluded PAPD5 analog design + TENT4B vs TENT4A enzymatic selectivity + DKC1/PARN iPSC-HSPC TERC northern/qPCR & Flow-FISH assay)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Pediatric Dyskeratosis Congenita qualifies for BOTH FDA Orphan Drug Designation AND a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV recent secondary-market sales: $100M-$158M non-dilutive exit catalyst), with huge expansion into ~15-20% of familial idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis!
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: Rare Pediatric PRV eligibility alone underwrites >$100M asset floor upon pediatric approval, prior to adult telomere-mediated IPF/cirrhosis expansion.

regulatory_pathway: FDA Rare Pediatric Disease Designation (PRV-eligible in Dyskeratosis Congenita) + Orphan Drug Designation + Fast Track.
first_90_days_milestones: Map PAPD5 (TENT4B) active-site selectivity vs TENT4A/ mitochondrial poly(A) polymerases and optimize BBB-excluded physicochemical properties (tPSA, P-gp).
Synthesize 30 peripheral-restricted dihydroquinolizinone / novel-core analogs via CRO.
Measure TERC 3'-tail trimming rescue and telomere elongation in engineered PARN/DKC1-mutant human cells via academic core SRA.
Apply for NHLBI Catalyze / SBIR Phase I and Team Telomere / Million Dollar Bike Ride research grant.

title: [PUBLIC-HEALTH-08] Pre-Conditioning Cryptic Telomere Biology Disorder Alert Preventing Fatal Transplant & Immunosuppression Toxicity
wet_lab_execution_model: 100% software EHR + germline variant-interpretation safety gate integrating lymphocyte Flow-FISH & TBD gene panel flags prior to HSCT, lung transplant, or IPF immunosuppression.
problem_wedge: Up to 70% of adult-onset Telomere Biology Disorders lack classic childhood nail/skin mucocutaneous triad ('cryptic TBD'), presenting instead as isolated 'idiopathic' aplastic anemia, 'cryptogenic' cirrhosis, or familial pulmonary fibrosis. Giving standard busulfan/alkylator HSCT conditioning or triple-therapy IPF immunosuppression to an unrecognized TBD patient causes >50-80% fatal organ toxicity—whereas dedicated radiation- and alkylator-free regimens (NCT01659606) achieve >85-90% engraftment survival.
solution_blueprint: Embed an automated pre-transplant & marrow-failure safety check across BMT, ILD, and hepatology EHR intake workflows scoring personal/family red flags (macrocytosis + premature graying <30 + cytopenias + ILD/cirrhosis) and ACMG/ClinGen telomere gene VUS reclassification to trigger urgent 1st-percentile lymphocyte Flow-FISH and route confirmed patients to alkylator-free protocols (NCT01659606).

unit_economics.initial_validation_budget_usd: $35,000 - $100,000 (FHIR pre-BMT/ILD risk scorer + ClinVar TERT/TERC/RTEL1/PARN structural-functional VUS classifier)
unit_economics.orphan_market_benchmark: Preventing a single fatal transplant conditioning complication saves transplant centers & payers $500,000-$1.5M+ in ICU/readmission outlays under bundled transplant contracts.
unit_economics.exit_or_revenue_comps: B2B clinical genomics & transplant-center quality/safety SaaS + specialty telomere diagnostic lab partnership.

regulatory_pathway: Transparent clinician-reviewable pre-conditioning safety checklist (21st Century Cures CDS exemption) + CLIA Flow-FISH/NGS partner integration.
first_90_days_milestones: Aggregate ClinVar, gnomAD, and published functional telomerase activity scores across 17 canonical TBD genes (TERT, TERC, DKC1, RTEL1, PARN, TINF2, ACD, CTC1, RPA1, ZCCHC8).
Co-design pre-BMT and ILD intake screening scorecard with Team Telomere Clinical Care Consortium centers.
Validate sensitivity on retrospective adult cryptogenic cytopenia + pulmonary fibrosis EHR cohorts.
Launch open clinician calculator + SMART-on-FHIR pre-conditioning alert pilot.
